place.en: The bank of the Si River

setup.zh: 修行靠日日不辍。今日功课：
setup.en: Cultivation is kept day by day. Today's practice:

label.en: Set out · Follow the river north

exits.means: sets out, travels on, or asks to move on

refuse.zh: 丹还没炼成。先把功课做完，路不会跑。
refuse.en: The pill isn't made yet. Finish the practice first — the road will wait.
